english.title: Pilot in command of aircraft taxi on apron or manoeuvring area without permission of person in charge of aerodrome
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the pilot in command of an aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), and taxied that aircraft on the apron or manoeuvring area at an uncontrolled aerodrome, namely **(..SPECIFY AERODROME..), without the permission of the person in charge of that aerodrome
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 12 of Schedule 1 to the Rules of the Air Regulations 2015 and articles 249(2) and 256(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
